items.title: 6.8 Carnot engine aur Carnot ka theorem (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.8 with Fig. 6.9 and Example 6.3 (PDF 130-132).

blocks.text: Sadi Carnot ne 1824 mein ek ideal engine bayan kiya jo sirf isothermal aur adiabatic processes istemal karta hai. Unhon ne dikhaya ke do mukhtalif temperature wale heat reservoirs ke darmiyan ideal reversible cycle mein chalne wala engine sab se zyada efficient (behtareen kaam karne wala) hoga. Ideal gas ko working substance le kar Carnot cycle PV diagram par dikhaya gaya hai (Fig. 6.9). Is ke chaar qadam hain:

blocks.alt: Carnot cycle A se B, C, D aur wapas A ka P-V graph, andar ka hissa rang bhara. A se B hara Isotherm, B se C zyada dhalwan magenta Adiabat, C se D wapas baen taraf hara Isotherm, D se A oopar magenta Adiabat; teer simt batate hain. A, D, B, C se dashed lakeeren V1, V4, V2, V3 tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.9: PV diagram par Carnot cycle (kitab ki Figure 6.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: AB: T₁ par isothermal phailao, heat Q₁ andar. BC: adiabatic phailao, temperature T₁ se T₂. CD: T₂ par isothermal dabao, heat Q₂ bahar. DA: adiabatic dabao, wapas T₁. Beech ka rang bhara area ek cycle mein engine ka kul work W hai.

items: Gas ko temperature T₁ par isothermal tareeqe se phailne diya jata hai; woh garam reservoir se heat Q₁ leti hai. Yeh curve AB hai.
Phir gas ko adiabatic tareeqe se phailne diya jata hai jab tak us ka temperature T₂ tak na gir jaye. Yeh curve BC hai.
Ab gas ko temperature T₂ par isothermal tareeqe se dabaya jata hai; woh thande reservoir ko heat Q₂ deti hai. Yeh curve CD hai.
Aakhir mein gas ko adiabatic tareeqe se daba kar temperature T₁ wali shuru ki halat mein wapas laya jata hai. Yeh curve DA hai.

blocks.text: Har waqt thermal aur mechanical equilibrium qaim rakha jata hai taake har process poori tarah reversible ho. Working substance shuru ki halat mein wapas aa jata hai, is liye us ki internal energy nahi badalti, yani ΔU = 0.
Ek cycle ka net work PV diagram par raste ABCDA ke andar ghire area ke barabar hai. Ise ek cycle mein jazb hui net heat ΔQ se bhi nikal sakte hain.

blocks.text_alt: ya   W = Q₁ − Q₂   (kyun ke ΔU = 0)

blocks.text: Heat engine ki efficiency η (eta) ki tareef:
Isothermal expansion ya compression mein energy ka len den Kelvin temperature ke mutabiq (proportional) hota hai. Is liye Q₁ aur Q₂ Kelvin temperatures T₁ aur T₂ ke mutabiq hain, aur:
Efficiency aam taur par percentage mein batai jati hai:

Yani Carnot engine ki efficiency sirf garam aur thande reservoirs ke temperature par depend karti hai; working substance kaun si hai, is se farq nahi parta. Dono reservoirs ke temperature ka farq jitna zyada, efficiency utni zyada. Magar efficiency kabhi 1 ya 100% nahi ho sakti, jab tak thanda reservoir absolute zero (T₂ = 0 K) par na ho.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Aabshaar (waterfall) heat engine ki misal hai: jaise pani oonchai se neeche girte hue pahiya ghumata hai, waise heat high temperature se low temperature ki taraf jate hue work karti hai.

Aise reservoirs milte nahi, is liye zyada se zyada efficiency hamesha 1 se kam rehti hai. Phir bhi Carnot cycle har heat engine ki efficiency ki oopri had (upper limit) bata deta hai. Koi asal heat engine poori tarah reversible nahi ho sakta aur energy ka kuch na kuch zaya hona lazmi hai. Yahi baat Carnot's theorem kehta hai:

blocks.title: Carnot's theorem
blocks.text: Do temperatures ke darmiyan chalne wala koi bhi heat engine, unhi do temperatures ke darmiyan chalne wale Carnot engine se zyada efficient nahi ho sakta.
Carnot's theorem ko aage barha kar yun bhi kaha jata hai:

blocks.title: Carnot's theorem (aage)
blocks.text: Ek hi do temperatures ke darmiyan chalne wale saare Carnot engines ki efficiency barabar hoti hai, working substance chahe koi bhi ho.

Aksar thanda reservoir kamre ke temperature ke qareeb hota hai. Is liye efficiency sirf garam reservoir ka temperature barha kar hi barhai ja sakti hai. Tamam asal heat engines friction aur heat ke doosre nuqsanaat ki wajah se Carnot engine se kam efficient hote hain.

blocks.title: Example 6.3
blocks.problem: Steam power plant ki turbine boiler se 427 °C par bhaap leti hai aur 77 °C wale thande reservoir mein chhorti hai. Zyada se zyada mumkin efficiency kitni hai?
steps: Do temperatures T₁ aur T₂ ke darmiyan kisi engine ki zyada se zyada efficiency: η = (T₁ − T₂)/T₁ × 100
Temperatures Kelvin mein: T₁ = 427 + 273 = 700 K, T₂ = 77 + 273 = 350 K
blocks.answer: Zyada se zyada efficiency 50% hai; asal turbine friction aur heat ke nuqsan ki wajah se is se kam degi.

blocks.prompt: Ek Carnot engine 600 K aur 300 K ke darmiyan chalta hai. Us ki zyada se zyada efficiency kya hai, aur garam reservoir se 500 J lene par woh kitna work karega? Kya 100% efficient heat engine mumkin hai?
blocks.explanation: η = 1 − 300/600 = 0.5 = 50%; W = η × Q₁ = 0.5 × 500 J = 250 J. Nahi: 100% ke liye T₂ = 0 K (absolute zero) wala thanda reservoir chahiye jo milta nahi, aur Carnot engine ko bhi apne sink ko heat Q₂ deni parti hai; asal engines friction aur heat ke nuqsan mein aur bhi zyada khote hain.

items: Carnot (1824): AB isothermal expansion (T₁ par Q₁ andar), BC adiabatic expansion, CD isothermal compression (T₂ par Q₂ bahar), DA adiabatic compression; W = Q₁ − Q₂ = ghira hua area.
η = (Q₁ − Q₂)/Q₁ = (T₁ − T₂)/T₁ = 1 − T₂/T₁; 100% sirf T₂ = 0 K par, jo mumkin nahi.
Carnot's theorem: koi engine Carnot engine se behtar nahi; ek hi do temperatures ke darmiyan saare Carnot engines ki efficiency barabar. Example 6.3: 50%.
